ledger.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete this transaction. This cannot be undone.
ledger.correctionPlaceholder: Type a correction (optional)... e.g. "the first one is wrong, it should be 80"
ledger.allocationMismatch: Some rows' split amounts don't add up to the total

calibrate.title: Clean up item names
calibrate.subtitle: Review the AI's suggestions before confirming. Edit directly, or tick a group and type guidance to have the AI try again.
calibrate.recheckThis: Send this group back to AI
calibrate.correctionPlaceholder: Type guidance for the ticked groups... e.g. "make it shorter"

transfer.title: Transfer between accounts
transfer.sameFund: Pick different funds for from and to

balance.title: Money on hand
balance.adjustSubtitle: Count what you actually have right now and type it in. The difference is recorded as an entry showing what it went from and to — this figure never resets on the cycle boundary, so leftover from previous cycles is already in it.
balance.deltaUp: more than recorded (income not yet entered)
balance.deltaDown: less than recorded (spending you forgot to enter)
balance.absorbHint: Daily by default — what goes unrecorded is usually day-to-day spending.

close.bannerTitle: {cycle} has ended but was never closed
close.bannerBody: ฿{amount} is still sitting in the daily/fixed funds. Leave it unclosed and that money drops off the books when the new cycle starts.
close.title: Close {cycle}
close.subtitle: Count what each fund actually held on the last day and type it in. The difference is recorded first, then the remainder is swept into savings — in that order, or spending you forgot to record gets swept into savings too and stays there for good.
close.sweepHint: After the sweep, daily and fixed land on exactly 0 and the new cycle starts from the budget you set.

settings.title: Settings
settings.cycleStartWarning: Changing this takes effect immediately and affects the calculation for the cycle in progress right now (deferring to next cycle isn't supported yet)
settings.resetDatabaseCaption: Permanently deletes all transactions (expenses/income/transfers). Settings, budgets, and categories are not affected.
settings.resetConfirmBody: This will permanently delete every transaction. This cannot be undone. (Settings, budgets, and categories will not be deleted.)
settings.vocabularyCaption: Previously used descriptions, given to the AI as examples so new entries reuse the same wording consistently. Editable — separate each entry with a comma (,).
settings.calibrateCaption: Let AI check for duplicate/inconsistent item names and merge them into one.
settings.reconcileCaption: Cash on hand not matching the app? (forgotten entries, or leftover carried from last cycle) Adjust any of the three funds to match.

dashboard.title: Daily Budget Tracker
dashboard.fixedCaption: Set aside for recurring expenses only (e.g. laundry/gas) — not general spending

reconcile.title: Match the recorded balance to real cash
reconcile.subtitle: Count what each fund actually holds and type it in. The gap is recorded as an "adjustment" entry showing what it went from and to. Funds you leave alone are untouched.
reconcile.deltaUp: unrecorded money in (e.g. last cycle’s leftover)
